entries.en:
Yazel Ahuatan has asked you to craft a bladder lining component so that he might mollify Methuli Cattlan. He has provided the materials, but the facilities are another matter; only those in Hyrstmill, under the care of Dametta, will do. Journey to the hamlet and request her permission.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.

entries.en: Dametta is willing to grant you permission to use her facilities─provided you carry out a simple task in exchange. She has prepared a hearty meal for Paulemont, a Wood Wailer stationed at E<-->Tatt's Spire. You need only deliver the meal and return with the sack which held her previous delivery. Alternatively, you could converse with the woman further and attempt to persuade her...but that approach may not end well.

entries.en:
The sack serves both to inflame Dametta's passions and satisfy her requirements. With the materials provided to you by Yazel Ahuatan, synthesize a bladder lining component, and deliver it to him at Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Production wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Dametta.

entries.en: I know that look─you've a mind to use these facilities, don't you? It's hardly the first time, suffice it to say. I find it quite flattering, actually─and who wouldn't? That the facilities I've worked so hard to maintain are in such high demand is high praise indeed!
entries.fr: Laissez-moi deviner. Vous êtes ici pour utiliser nos ins<->tal<->la<->tions d'artisanat, n'est-ce pas<nbsp>? Il faut dire aussi qu'il n'y a pas grand-chose d'autre à faire dans le coin...
entries.ja:
あー、あんた職人さんだね？
はいはい、心得てるよ。
ここの作業台を使って、仕事したいってんだろ？

entries.en: However! That same demand means that I cannot allow unrestricted access, I'm sorry to say. Oh, don't look at me like that! Can you imagine the state they would be in if I let every traveler have the run of the place? It'd be no better than a pigsty!
entries.fr: Je vous y autoriserai avec plaisir, dès que vous aurez fait quelque chose pour moi en échange. En fait, j'ai ici un panier-repas pour un vigile sombre, mais les bois sont trop dangereux pour que je lui apporte moi-même... Pourriez-vous vous en occuper à ma place<nbsp>?
entries.ja:
こっちはかまわないけど、ひとつお願いがあるんだよね。
鬼哭隊の隊士さんに、差し入れを届けておくれよ。
最近、魔物が多くてねぇ、女ひとりで出歩くのは危険なのさ。

entries.en: Such a dedicated Wailer, Paulemont is─and kind, too! I used to send him Mun<-->Tuy tonic, and do you know what he did? He shared it with his comrades when supplies ran low!
entries.macro: Such a dedicated Wailer, Paulemont is─and kind, too! I used to send him Mun<-->Tuy tonic, and do you know what he did? He shared it with his comrades when supplies ran low!
entries.fr: En fait, Paulemont est un vigile sombre qui patrouille ré<->gu<->liè<->re<->ment entre le Moulin des Bois et la tour d'E-Tatt. Pour le remercier de faire son travail con<->scien<->cieu<->sement, je lui ai offert une bouteille de mon fameux lait de Mun-Tuy, un geste qu'il a beaucoup apprécié.

ポールモンさんは、ここら一帯の警備をしてる隊士さんでね。
いつもご苦労さんって、ムントゥイ豆乳をおすそわけしたら、
すっかり気に入ってくれたんだよ。

entries.en: Is that from Dametta? I, uh... Thank you! Here, don't forget this! No need for her to come all this way to fetch an empty sack, am I right?

entries.en: My word, would you look how spotless it is! Nothing more satisfying than seeing that your man─ahem, that your <italic(1)>friend<italic(0)> didn't leave a single crumb. Ahem. Ah, yes, your materials! Though unusual, I don't believe they could be used for evil ends. Here you are. You'll note I didn't return them all─there are several times the required materials, it would seem. Whoever entrusted this task to you left a note in the bag: “To featherless neuker, give only required parts. In case of failure, retain spares.” Hmmm... What in the world is a “neuker”?
